requirements.heading: Representation of Line Breaks
requirements.text: The canonical form of any MIME "text" subtype MUST always represent a line break as a CRLF sequence.

requirements.heading: Representation of Line Breaks
requirements.text: Similarly, any occurrence of CRLF in MIME "text" MUST represent a line break.

requirements.heading: Charset Parameter
requirements.text: messages containing characters coded according to other versions of ISO 646 than US-ASCII and the 1991 IRV, or using code-switching procedures (e.g., those of ISO 2022), as well as 8bit or multiple octet character encodings MUST use an appropriate character set specification to be consistent with MIME.

requirements.heading: Charset Parameter
requirements.text: For example, if a body contains only US-ASCII characters, it SHOULD be marked as being in the US- ASCII character set, not ISO-8859-1, which, like all the ISO-8859 family of character sets, is a superset of US-ASCII.

requirements.heading: Multipart Media Type
requirements.text: The boundary delimiter MUST NOT appear inside any of the encapsulated parts, on a line by itself or as the prefix of any line.

requirements.heading: Common Syntax
requirements.text: The boundary delimiter MUST occur at the beginning of a line, i.e., following a CRLF, and the initial CRLF is considered to be attached to the boundary delimiter line rather than part of the preceding part.

requirements.heading: Common Syntax
requirements.text: transport-padding := *LWSP-char ; Composers MUST NOT generate ; non-zero length transport ; padding, but receivers MUST ; be able to handle padding ; added by message transports.

requirements.heading: External-Body Subtype
requirements.text: The encapsulated headers in ALL "message/external-body" entities MUST include a Content-ID header field to give a unique identifier by which to reference the data.

requirements.heading: External-Body Subtype
requirements.text: As with "message/partial", MIME entities of type "message/external- body" MUST have a content-transfer-encoding of 7bit (the default).

requirements.heading: General External-Body Parameters
requirements.text: This parameter is unconditionally mandatory and MUST be present on EVERY "message/external-body".
